# Donald Trump’s Approval Rating On Strongest Issue Hits All-Time Low

Published

Aug 30, 2026 at 06:00 AM EDT

Sam Stevenson

Associate News Editor

President Donald Trump’s handling of immigration has fallen to its weakest position in an Economist/YouGov tracker, a striking reversal on the issue that powered his return to the White House. [...] The deterioration was not linear. Net approval stood at minus one in April 2025, reached parity in May, and then remained negative through the rest of the series.

It registered minus eight at the turn of February 2026 before reaching minus 13 in both May and August.

results.content: The Economist Approval Tracker — Net approval at -27 as of August 11, inflation/prices approval at -44, state-by-state projections showing dissatisfaction across Trump-won states [...] The erosion of support in this age group reflects broader economic dissatisfaction. Trump’s net approval rating for handling inflation and prices reached -44 in August, the lowest it has been this term, according to the Economist tracker. Before the resumption of conflict with Iran in mid-July, the average price for a gallon of gasoline was under $3; it has since climbed to around $4, compounding voter frustration with economic conditions.
